scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
reason: The existing getcred API returns a scratch pointer without establishing that an ignored offload result initialized the consumed credential values. An initialized-only HOST fixture cannot establish that production requirement. The uncompiled draft is preserved as evidence and excluded from the ready source and all planned commands.
source_contract: No Rust may read uninitialized credential output. No checked fetch semantics are inferred from this API. Prior uninitialized C behavior is not a defined error oracle.
